flows.name: Read mapped legacy branch records
steps: Authenticate as a recognized active internal non-admin
Add a rolled-back Finance fake-project membership
Read unrestricted, Finance, and mismatched Meetings and Tasks
Change the same principal to an external contact and repeat the open read
flows.expectedOutcome: Unrestricted legacy rows are visible only to internal staff; Finance and mismatched rows remain hidden without exact Finance membership

claims.description: Finance and mismatched rows remain hidden from a Finance fake-project member without exact branch membership.
Active internal staff can read unrestricted mapped legacy rows and external contacts cannot.
The signed source endpoint supports every RLS-visible document category and rejects unsafe source URLs.
